about: Perth East is a township in Perth County, Ontario, covering Milverton, Shakespeare, and surrounding Mennonite and farm country east of Stratford—not a city. Quiet villages, horse-and-buggy roads, and rich Perth County agriculture share the landscape. About 13,000 people live in Perth East Township.
